timing: before implementation, synthetic tests, GPU smoke, formal training, or new method validation access
reason: run a new same-runner uniform control so tiny per-case reduction differences cannot confound the aggregation factor

supersedes.old_control_plan: reuse archived KAS teacher-free control as the sole matched causal control
supersedes.new_control_plan: train uniform_mean8 and batch_cvar50_top4 in parallel with the same new runner; archived control remains a historical comparator

accurate_method_name: source-inspired batch-empirical CVaR50 / Average-Top4-of8 on per-scan DiceCE
source_boundaries: source image-level AT-k ranks the entire train image set, not each minibatch
source fixed AT10% begins at epoch2; its ACDC 2D-slice Dice decreased for both reported backbones
source curriculum N-to5% plus sigmoid boxcar smoothing is not implemented
source full method also contains pixel Bottom-all-but-sigma filtering, not implemented
batch top4/8 is not dataset,subject,or population CVaR and has no BraTS/true3D evidence

uniform_mean8.aggregation: arithmetic mean of all8 attached per-draw DiceCE losses

batch_cvar50_top4.aggregation: arithmetic mean of the four attached per-draw DiceCE losses with largest detached values

only_changed_factor: batch aggregation mean8 versus largest4 mean

per_draw_loss.unit: scan draw after independent augmentation; duplicate case IDs remain separate draws
per_draw_loss.dice: same MONAI DiceLoss semantics as historical DiceCELoss: sigmoid=true,squared_pred=false,smooth_nr=1e-5,smooth_dr=1e-5,batch=false
per_draw_loss.ce: BCEWithLogits reduction=none then channel/spatial mean per draw
per_draw_loss.dtype: bfloat16 model forward; float32 per-draw loss and aggregation

stable_selection.selected_loss_path: index original attached per_draw_loss and mean
stable_selection.duplicate_draws: may occupy multiple selected positions; never deduplicate

parity_and_pairing_gates: uniform per-draw mean matches legacy DiceCELoss scalar within1e-7 in value and raw-logit gradient
uniform full-model one-step AdamW update matches legacy scalar path exactly or within frozen tensor tolerance before formal
uniform and CVaR arms initial state,first batch,201-232 case order,and CUDA RNG hashes are identical
all8 per-draw values finite; stable selected indices equal a manual lexicographic reference
selection and aggregation consume no CPU/CUDA RNG

validation.selection: candidate maximum Scan, then Subject, then earlier epoch
validation.bottom27_gate: candidate minus new uniform mean Dice strictly positive
validation.boundary27_gate: candidate minus new uniform mean Dice nonnegative
